title: Pentagon weighs pulling nearly a third of U.S. forces from Europe
byline: Dan De Luce, Gordon Lubold, Courtney Kube, Abigail Williams
excerpt: Current proposals from the Pentagon call for 25,000 to 50,000 troops to be removed from Europe as part of Pentagon policy chief Bridge Colby’s plan to realign American forces in Europe.
content_html:
EXCLUSIVE

FOR SUBSCRIBERS

The potentially drastic drawdown of 25,000 or more U.S. troops comes amid warnings from NATO allies about a growing threat posed by Russia.

Sept. 17, 2026, 4:06 PM EDT

WASHINGTON — The Pentagon is weighing a drastic plan to pull planes, ships, weapons and tens of thousands of U.S. troops from Europe, despite warnings from NATO allies about the growing threat of Russian aggression, according to seven current and former U.S. and Western officials.
